```
def _process_text(block: 'BlockParser', text: str, loose: bool) ->List[Any]:
    text = TRIM_RE.sub('', text)
    text = strip_end(text)
    if loose:
        children, state = block.parse(text, {})
        return children
    else:
        # tight: wrap in paragraph-like inline content
        lines = text.splitlines()
        # strip the leading colon replacement (already done by caller)
        children = []
        for line in lines:
            line = line.strip()
            if line:
                children.append({'type': 'inline', 'raw': line})
        # Actually parse as block but treat paragraphs as inline
        state = block.state_cls()
        state.src = text
        block.parse(text, state)
        tokens = state.tokens if hasattr(state, 'tokens') else []
        return tokens
```
